Location: Toronto, ON, CA Date Posted: 2026-06-30 Job Type: full Remote: yes Salary: $70,000 Job URL: https://ats.rippling.com/spccard_careers/jobs/c5c2f217-7a79-4840-94e1-008d143ba60a?jobSite=Indeed Source: indeed Job Description: **Reports to:** Senior Marketing Manager **Salary Range:** $70,000 \- $80,000 CAD **Vacancy Disclosure:** This posting is for an existing vacancy. **AI Disclosure:** SPC does not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position **Location:** Vaughan (Vaughan Mills Area) or Toronto (Dundas \& Bathurst Area) **About SPC Student Price Card Ltd.** SPC is committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable legislation. Are you passionate about shaping design excellence with Canada's \#1 Loyalty Program for Students? We’re a dynamic, marketing and product\-led company dedicated to enhancing student life by providing savings for every need. We’re seeking a talented Senior Graphic Designer with a keen eye for detail and fresh, creative ideas to help lead our design efforts and elevate our brand. #### **Role Overview:** As a Senior Graphic Designer, you will play a key role in bringing the SPC brand to life across marketing, product, partnerships, and sales initiatives. You will be responsible for creating high\-impact visual assets that drive engagement, support business objectives, and deliver a consistent brand experience across all channels. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, you'll contribute to the development of campaigns, digital experiences, partner promotions, presentations, and marketing materials that resonate with student audiences. This role requires a strong combination of creative thinking, design expertise, and strategic problem\-solving, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled designer with a passion for branding, digital marketing, and user experience, who thrives on collaboration and takes pride in producing exceptional creative work from concept through execution. #### **K****ey Responsibilities** **Brand \& Creative Development** * Create engaging visual assets that support marketing campaigns, partner promotions, and company initiatives. * Ensure consistency across all creative deliverables while maintaining SPC's brand standards. * Contribute ideas that strengthen and evolve the visual identity of SPC. * Translate business goals into effective visual solutions that resonate with student audiences. **Design Execution** * Design digital advertising creative for web, mobile, social media, email, and paid marketing channels. * Create presentations, one\-pagers, sales collateral, promotional materials, and branded assets. * Produce creative assets across digital, print, experiential, and out\-of\-home channels. * Prepare production\-ready files and coordinate design assets for internal and external stakeholders. **Product \& UX/UI Design** * Collaborate with product and development teams to support user\-focused design initiatives. * Create wireframes, mockups, user flows, and visual designs for digital experiences. * Apply UX/UI best practices to improve engagement and usability. * Iterate designs based on feedback, testing, and business requirements. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner closely with Marketing, Partnerships, Product, and external vendors to deliver high\-quality creative. * Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders. * Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and deadlines. * Stay current with emerging design trends, digital experiences, and Gen Z / Gen Alpha consumer behaviour. **What You Bring** * Strong visual design skills with a portfolio demonstrating digital, brand, and marketing work. * Excellent understanding of typography, layout, composition, colour theory, and visual hierarchy. * Ability to balance creativity with business objectives. * Strong communication and presentation skills. * Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. **Technical Skills** * Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign). * Experience with Figma and modern UX/UI design workflows. * Experience creating digital marketing assets across multiple channels. * Proficiency in AI tools for graphic design work * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and presentation design. * Familiarity with motion graphics, video editing, or animation is considered an asset. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of graphic design experience. * Post\-secondary education in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Fine Arts, or a related discipline. * Strong portfolio showcasing brand, digital, marketing, and UX/UI work. * Experience working in consumer, retail, e\-commerce, loyalty or media environments is considered an asset. * Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. **How we work :** You aren’t just valued for your experience and skillsets, but equally for your growth mindset and attitude. We work as a flat organization, working collaboratively as a team and showing up every day as our authentic selves. Our team knows that creative solutions require a diverse approach to thinking and life experiences. SPC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. Our hiring process is inclusive of all candidates regardless of their race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or, disability status. Job Index 2: Job Title: Coordinator, Visitor Experience & Special Events Company Name: OCAD University Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid: on-campus 3 days per week and remote 2 days per week, subject to change based on operational needs) Date Posted: July 7, 2026 Job Type: intern Remote: yes Salary: $50,163.56 to $57,378.18 per annum Job URL: https://tre.tbe.taleo.net/tre01/ats/careers/v2/viewRequisition?org=OCADU&cws=37&rid=3806 Source: OCADU Taleo (cws=37) Job Description: OCAD University acknowledges the ancestral territories of the Mississaugas of the Credit, the Haudenosaunee, the Anishinaabeg and the Huron-Wendat, who are the original owners and custodians of the land on which we live, work and create OCAD University , Canada’s largest and oldest art and design university, is a vibrant community of bold, curious and compassionate artists, designers and scholars who are imagining and creating a joyful, equitable and sustainable world. The University is an internationally renowned hub for art, design, digital media, research, innovation and creativity, and arts administration. It embraces collaborative and interdisciplinary approaches to change-making through art, design-thinking curriculum and research, making OCAD U a local, regional, national and global leader in art and design. It is an exciting time to join the OCAD U community as the University is at a key stage in its institutional transformation, with the implementation of its Academic and Strategic Plan and guiding principles — driving positive impact; decolonization, indigenization and equity; environmental sustainability; emerging as a vibrant hub; student centered approaches; innovation in learning teaching and research; and financial stewardship. Reporting to the Manager, Student Recruitment and the Manager, Undergraduate Admissions, the Coordinator, Visitor Experience & Special Events leads online and in-person front-of-house and special event support for the Admissions & Recruitment office. The Coordinator ensures visitors, applicants and new students receive accurate and timely information about applying to and attending OCAD University (OCAD U). The Coordinator works closely with team members and campus partners to create a supportive and welcoming environment to ensure visitors have the best experience when on campus or attending special events. This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangements; however, a minimum of four days per week of on-campus work is required, with flexibility to adjust on-campus days and hours to meet department needs. Occasional evening and weekend work will be required, with shift premiums applied in accordance with the Collective Agreement. All flexibility and scheduling provisions are subject to the terms outlined in the Collective Agreement. Summary of Responsibilities : Welcome Centre Responsibilities Working with Admissions & Recruitment staff and leading a team of students, coordinate frontline support for the Admissions & Recruitment office, including responding to or redirecting telephone/email inquiries from prospective students, parent(s)/guardian(s), guidance counsellors, teachers, and the general public Coordinate the recruitment and hiring of student monitors (i.e., student tour guides) and provide/facilitate relevant training on important tour information and best practices (e.g. health and safety, AODA, etc.) Coordinate and oversee the logistics of drop-in and scheduled on-campus tours, including booking system management and determining staffing needs for tours (i.e. student tour guides), and student support coverage for the office and other on-campus events. In consultation with the Admissions & Recruitment team, work with on-campus partners (e.g. Facilities & Studio Services) to create a welcoming and informed experience for visitors Implement process improvement to create better experiences for guests on campus and at events (i.e. reception inefficiencies, email/phone response times, in-person reception, campus tours etc.) Maintain a tidy and welcoming Welcome Centre to ensure a pleasant experience, including furniture and table arrangement, and print materials Perform administrative duties such as processing and distributing incoming/outgoing mail, booking rooms, ordering office supplies, preparing work order requests, and track walk-ins Admissions Responsibilities Coordinate, schedule, and staff online info sessions including Meet-a-Student sessions, 1:1 advising appointments, and other online info sessions as required Respond to applicant inquiries regarding admission requirements, application process, and applicants’ status using student information systems (Slate, Colleague, etc.) and triage as needed Support the Admissions team and Office of the Registrar with new first year students’ registration assistance as needed Refer applicants to transition programming available to incoming students through other OCAD U departments (i.e. Campus Life, Centre for Learning and Teaching, Registrar’s Office, Student Accessibility Services, etc.) Recruitment Responsibilities Coordinate major events with the Admissions & Recruitment team such as Open House, National Portfolio Day, Grad Ex VIP and plan logistics such as room booking, staffing, and catering across OCAD U units and departments, as required Support the Recruitment and Admissions team with portfolio reviews as needed Represent OCAD U at on-campus and off-campus student recruitment events, including portfolio review events and school visits, as required General Responsibilities Contribute to the development of diversity, equity, inclusivity, and accessibility (DEIA) strategies throughout all programs, services and communications Assist the Manager, Student Recruitment, Manager, Undergraduate Admissions, and other Admissions & Recruitment staff in other related duties contributing to the successful operation of the Admissions & Recruitment office Qualifications : Post-secondary degree in art & design, or equivalent Minimum of two (2) years of administrative work experience, preferably in a post-secondary educational institution Willing and able to work evenings and weekends as required Knowledge of Ontario, Canadian and International Secondary School curriculum Demonstrated experience in initiating process improvement projects related to customer experience Experience with CRM and/or event registration systems Demonstrated strength in customer service, and the ability to exercise professionalism in dealing with people Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills Demonstrated experience and comfort with public speaking and presentations An interest in building relationships with prospective students coming from diverse backgrounds Demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines Ability to work independently and participate collaboratively in a team environment Ability to understand and adapt to multiple priorities, processes, and workflows Demonstrated commitment to the principles of equity and diversity and experience promoting a respectful work and learning environment for students, staff and faculty Working knowledge of all Microsoft applications; familiarity with database applications an asset Mode of Work: Hybrid: on-campus 3 days per week and remote 2 days per week, subject to change based on operational needs Compensation: Hiring Range - $50,163.56 to $57,378.18 per annum, commensurate with experience, plus benefits; Salary Range - $50,163.56 to $65,081.34 per annum. Hours of Work : Monday to Friday • Willing and able to work evenings and weekends as required This role may occasionally require work outside of regular business hours in order to support operational requirements. Any overtime, scheduling adjustments, or flex time arrangements will be managed in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Collective Agreement and University policies, including any required approvals This posting is for an existing vacancy. Application Deadline: Interested applicants are invited to submit an updated * resume and cover letter ( PDF )by selecting "Apply Now" below, no later than Tuesday July 7, 2026. * Please upload your resume and cover letter as one PDF . Please name your upload: FirstName_LastName-Job Code As an employer committed to employment equity, we encourage applications from members of equity-deserving communities including women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions. OCAD University is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free experience to applicants with accessibility needs. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage during the recruitment process. Please contact People & Culture for more information or refer to OCAD U’s Policy of Accommodation in Employment for Persons with Disabilities All qualified persons are encouraged to apply; however, Canadians and permanent residents of Canada will be given priority. While we thank all candidates for their interest, only those short-listed will be contacted. Job Index 1: Job Title: Coordinator, Visitor Experience & Special Events Company Name: OCAD University Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid: on-campus 3 days per week and remote 2 days per week, subject to change based on operational needs) Date Posted: July 7, 2026 Job Type: intern Remote: yes Salary: $50,163.56 to $57,378.18 per annum Job URL: https://tre.tbe.taleo.net/tre01/ats/careers/v2/viewRequisition?org=OCADU&cws=37&rid=3806 Source: OCADU Taleo (cws=37) Job Description: OCAD University acknowledges the ancestral territories of the Mississaugas of the Credit, the Haudenosaunee, the Anishinaabeg and the Huron-Wendat, who are the original owners and custodians of the land on which we live, work and create OCAD University , Canada’s largest and oldest art and design university, is a vibrant community of bold, curious and compassionate artists, designers and scholars who are imagining and creating a joyful, equitable and sustainable world. The University is an internationally renowned hub for art, design, digital media, research, innovation and creativity, and arts administration. It embraces collaborative and interdisciplinary approaches to change-making through art, design-thinking curriculum and research, making OCAD U a local, regional, national and global leader in art and design. It is an exciting time to join the OCAD U community as the University is at a key stage in its institutional transformation, with the implementation of its Academic and Strategic Plan and guiding principles — driving positive impact; decolonization, indigenization and equity; environmental sustainability; emerging as a vibrant hub; student centered approaches; innovation in learning teaching and research; and financial stewardship. Reporting to the Manager, Student Recruitment and the Manager, Undergraduate Admissions, the Coordinator, Visitor Experience & Special Events leads online and in-person front-of-house and special event support for the Admissions & Recruitment office. The Coordinator ensures visitors, applicants and new students receive accurate and timely information about applying to and attending OCAD University (OCAD U). The Coordinator works closely with team members and campus partners to create a supportive and welcoming environment to ensure visitors have the best experience when on campus or attending special events. This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangements; however, a minimum of four days per week of on-campus work is required, with flexibility to adjust on-campus days and hours to meet department needs. Occasional evening and weekend work will be required, with shift premiums applied in accordance with the Collective Agreement. All flexibility and scheduling provisions are subject to the terms outlined in the Collective Agreement. Summary of Responsibilities : Welcome Centre Responsibilities Working with Admissions & Recruitment staff and leading a team of students, coordinate frontline support for the Admissions & Recruitment office, including responding to or redirecting telephone/email inquiries from prospective students, parent(s)/guardian(s), guidance counsellors, teachers, and the general public Coordinate the recruitment and hiring of student monitors (i.e., student tour guides) and provide/facilitate relevant training on important tour information and best practices (e.g. health and safety, AODA, etc.) Coordinate and oversee the logistics of drop-in and scheduled on-campus tours, including booking system management and determining staffing needs for tours (i.e. student tour guides), and student support coverage for the office and other on-campus events. In consultation with the Admissions & Recruitment team, work with on-campus partners (e.g. Facilities & Studio Services) to create a welcoming and informed experience for visitors Implement process improvement to create better experiences for guests on campus and at events (i.e. reception inefficiencies, email/phone response times, in-person reception, campus tours etc.) Maintain a tidy and welcoming Welcome Centre to ensure a pleasant experience, including furniture and table arrangement, and print materials Perform administrative duties such as processing and distributing incoming/outgoing mail, booking rooms, ordering office supplies, preparing work order requests, and track walk-ins Admissions Responsibilities Coordinate, schedule, and staff online info sessions including Meet-a-Student sessions, 1:1 advising appointments, and other online info sessions as required Respond to applicant inquiries regarding admission requirements, application process, and applicants’ status using student information systems (Slate, Colleague, etc.) and triage as needed Support the Admissions team and Office of the Registrar with new first year students’ registration assistance as needed Refer applicants to transition programming available to incoming students through other OCAD U departments (i.e. Campus Life, Centre for Learning and Teaching, Registrar’s Office, Student Accessibility Services, etc.) Recruitment Responsibilities Coordinate major events with the Admissions & Recruitment team such as Open House, National Portfolio Day, Grad Ex VIP and plan logistics such as room booking, staffing, and catering across OCAD U units and departments, as required Support the Recruitment and Admissions team with portfolio reviews as needed Represent OCAD U at on-campus and off-campus student recruitment events, including portfolio review events and school visits, as required General Responsibilities Contribute to the development of diversity, equity, inclusivity, and accessibility (DEIA) strategies throughout all programs, services and communications Assist the Manager, Student Recruitment, Manager, Undergraduate Admissions, and other Admissions & Recruitment staff in other related duties contributing to the successful operation of the Admissions & Recruitment office Qualifications : Post-secondary degree in art & design, or equivalent Minimum of two (2) years of administrative work experience, preferably in a post-secondary educational institution Willing and able to work evenings and weekends as required Knowledge of Ontario, Canadian and International Secondary School curriculum Demonstrated experience in initiating process improvement projects related to customer experience Experience with CRM and/or event registration systems Demonstrated strength in customer service, and the ability to exercise professionalism in dealing with people Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills Demonstrated experience and comfort with public speaking and presentations An interest in building relationships with prospective students coming from diverse backgrounds Demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines Ability to work independently and participate collaboratively in a team environment Ability to understand and adapt to multiple priorities, processes, and workflows Demonstrated commitment to the principles of equity and diversity and experience promoting a respectful work and learning environment for students, staff and faculty Working knowledge of all Microsoft applications; familiarity with database applications an asset Mode of Work: Hybrid: on-campus 3 days per week and remote 2 days per week, subject to change based on operational needs Compensation: Hiring Range - $50,163.56 to $57,378.18 per annum, commensurate with experience, plus benefits; Salary Range - $50,163.56 to $65,081.34 per annum. Hours of Work : Monday to Friday • Willing and able to work evenings and weekends as required This role may occasionally require work outside of regular business hours in order to support operational requirements. Any overtime, scheduling adjustments, or flex time arrangements will be managed in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Collective Agreement and University policies, including any required approvals This posting is for an existing vacancy. Application Deadline: Interested applicants are invited to submit an updated * resume and cover letter ( PDF )by selecting "Apply Now" below, no later than Tuesday July 7, 2026. * Please upload your resume and cover letter as one PDF . Please name your upload: FirstName_LastName-Job Code As an employer committed to employment equity, we encourage applications from members of equity-deserving communities including women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions. OCAD University is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free experience to applicants with accessibility needs. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage during the recruitment process. Please contact People & Culture for more information or refer to OCAD U’s Policy of Accommodation in Employment for Persons with Disabilities All qualified persons are encouraged to apply; however, Canadians and permanent residents of Canada will be given priority. While we thank all candidates for their interest, only those short-listed will be contacted.
